title: lupinaster pentaphyllus subsp. albus
intro: Lupinaster pentaphyllus subsp. albus, commonly known as White-fruited Tree-lupin, is a rare and unique subspecies of the Lupinaster pentaphyllus plant, belonging to the family Oleaceae. The health benefits of White-fruited Tree-lupin include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress.
